article.title: The EOI Window Journal
article.description: Anirudh Shetty's (36, engineering manager) third launch-day hunt — a RERA-feed ritual that reads filings before hoardings exist, a refundable-EOI rule written in blood, delivery histories pulled from RERA's own records, and a coffee rule that caps allotment-day adrenaline at zero rupees.
article.quote: "The best price a flat will ever have is before it exists."

learnings.text: EOI refundability 'as per company policy' is not refundability — ₹2L held hostage for eleven weeks taught him the rule: 'refundable within 14 days, in writing,' or no cheque
RERA delivery records beat sales-head charm — the developer whose last three projects delivered within 4 months of promise got the booking; the one with the better renders is now 19 months late
The OC-day exit window is the discipline — list three weeks before OC, close two weeks after, before fourteen neighbour listings crowd the market at 7% below his price

chatMessages.text: Riya, tomorrow's the allotment. Nine a.m. token, marre. I need you to do the thing we agreed. Say it back to me.

Your pre-commitment, on record. East-facing, floors eight through fourteen, the two towers away from the club. Budget locked at two-point-four-five all-in — floor rise and PLC included, negotiated at booking, not after. And if the counter offers a 'special today-only upgrade'… you step out of the hall, call me, and drink one full coffee before answering. The eight-lakh rule. And remember — the oversubscription board in the hall is theatre; real scarcity doesn't need a countdown font that big. If the east-facing mid-floors are gone, the refundable EOI comes home with you, and we wait for the next credible launch. The best price a flat will ever have is before it exists — but only the RIGHT flat, at the right floor.

tabs.adviceDescription: For launch-window buyers, the checklist is the edge: RERA registration filed and land title in the developer's name before any EOI; refundability in writing ('within 14 days'), never 'as per company policy'; a price sheet rather than 'indicative pricing'; and delivery histories pulled from RERA's own records. Decode the choreography — the EOI collection builds the oversubscribed story, the 'valid today only' price is valid for six weeks, and floor-rise plus PLC quietly add 6%. Negotiate the extras at booking, when the cheque still has power. Pre-commit against allotment-day adrenaline: name the rule, write the budget, and step out for a full coffee before answering. And pre-write the exit: list three weeks before OC, close two weeks after, before the neighbours' listings crowd. The best price a flat will ever have is before it exists — but only the right flat, at the right floor.
